creditAllowance.note: Intentionally empty in the seed. The skill fills this on first use by fetching GET /copilot_internal/user -> quota_snapshots.premium_interactions (see REFERENCE.md § Credit allowance and balance). Do not seed a figure: monthly entitlement is account-specific, and the published per-seat numbers (1900 Business / 3900 Enterprise) are starting points an organisation may raise per user - one verified account reported plan 'business' against an actual entitlement of 15000. If the fetch fails, the skill expresses cost in money alone rather than guessing an allowance.
